book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: Ŋwa wù fwe wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ Timoti le

content: Kune bamii ba n'yɛyɛ wu chimbiaŋ
Kiyo ki Yuude jɛme waaŋ lɛ, lé gê nyûme kife kimi le, bamii bamu chînɛ mbɛmɛ le bo yûge wa mwɛɛ nyume a biyo bì lɛɛde bɛ bamii le mo ban'yɛyɛ ba banchɛndaa ba debele lɛ.
Ban'yɛyɛ banɛ lé bo gê bo tôo chiaaŋ yi bamii ba jiɛnyi bo buuse bamii ba mbiane chimbiaŋ, muntele muboo chii wa gɛh njɛ ba toŋ nyume bɛ kichvu.

Bo lé bo gê bo fâŋe lɛ keefɛ bamii tâashi bvuguu gɛ, bɛ lɛ keefɛ muh jîi kfuu chi mwɛɛ mumu gɛ. Mwɛɛ munɛ le Nyo gɛ̀ fɛ lɛ bamii jîi, bamii ba kɛme mbɛmɛ bo ka kee nchiɛɛŋ doo bo jii bo nyâa kiyone Nyo le.
Fiɛɛ fichii fi Nyo gɛ̀ fɛ joŋe lo, gɛ fimi nyume yu fi muh fâŋe gɛ, nɛ wu fii bɛ kiyone fɛ Nyo le,
nje njɛmɛ wù Nyo bɛ buunɛ ge wa fi tu fi yuude.
Mwa lɛme wu Kletu Jiso wù joŋe
Nɛ wo duunyi mwɛɛ munɛ booŋ ba bwee wese besabɛŋ le, wo ge wo nyûme muh wu lɛme wu Kletu Jiso wù joŋe wu lɛyi kikwɛɛ ke bɛ jɛ yi Nyo yì le kune mbɛmɛ bɛ n'yɛyɛ wù joŋe wù wo bii wu le.
Keefɛ wo kɛ̂me fiɛɛ fì wo gê bɛ mumaŋa mu achiji mu le njɛ mu kɛme fiɛɛ ki mu gê bɛ Nyo sɛŋ. Yɛyɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ ki wo chêe kinche nyume kì Nyo goone.

Ki muh ŋgûune ŋgune wu yaase ye, fi kɛme gɛh mbe fɛ wu le. Geenɛ ki muh chêe nyume kinche ki Nyo goone, fi kɛme mbe fɛ wu le a jé le yichii, nje finɛ fiɛɛ kɛme maajɛ yi kinche kì mɛɛse le, fi ka kɛme yi kinche kì too le.
Wunɛ njɛmɛ le wu nchiɛɛŋ, nyume njɛmɛ wu le wu kojɛ wu muh le wu bɛ̂ɛŋ wu le, wu ka maŋe gɛ.
Nɛ fiɛɛ fì bee luume bɛ lɛme chinɛ wesee nje bee le be leesɛ bvufee bwesa bvuchii yi Nyo wù kɛme kinche le. Nyo le Mbvusɛ wù bamii bachii, fede mwɛɛ munchii fɛ bamii ba le ba bɛɛŋ wu le.
Wo yɛ̂yi bamii bɛ mwɛɛ munɛ, wo duu lɛ bo gêe mu.

Keefɛ wo chînɛ lɛ muh jôde wo fɛkuu njɛ wo baaŋ chumu gɛ. Wo nyume njiŋɛ fɛ bamii ba mbɛmɛ le, a je yì wo jɛme yi le bɛ kinche kuŋ, mo kiŋkoŋɛ kì wo kɛme, mo fitele fì wo lese yi Nyo le, mo je yì wo gɛɛde ye yo lɛ yi yûude le.
Nyâ kikwɛɛ kuŋ ki wo tɛ̂ŋe Ŋwa wu Nyo fɛ bamii ba mbɛmɛ le fɛ waaŋ, wo ka fêeji jɛ yi Nyo, wo yɛyi tɛ bo gɛɛŋ bu sege nlé ŋgê ntô.
Keefɛ wo nôŋ nya yo gɛ. Nnya yinɛ le yì ba gɛ̀ nya wo le sege ŋgoo yi bachiji bikwɛɛ bi kintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ gɛ̀ gɛlɛ chiaaŋ yiboo yi ye yo le, ntuŋ wu bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo to fɛ wo le.
Nyâ kikwɛɛ kuŋ yi mwɛɛ munɛ le, wo gêe mwɛɛ munɛ munchii bamii bachii yɛde ŋgɛnɛ fwe wo le.
Wo yɛ̂ne bɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ mo bɛ n'yɛyɛ wo. Wo jîji yu chuule wu lɛ no wo gee noo, wo gê wo bvûsɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ, wo bvûsɛ tɛ mo bamii ba yuge fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme le.
